name: UnipolSai
verdict: Merged into Unipol Assicurazioni S.p.A. (Milan-listed) in December 2024. Nothing found.
note: Official Sponsor of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to unipolsai.com, stands under 'Official Sponsors' with the line 'Insurance' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): UnipolSai was merged into Unipol Assicurazioni S.p.A., listed in Milan, at the end of 2024 (unipolsai-merger-2025); Unipol's shareholders above 3% at 9 June 2026 are Italian cooperatives and their holding companies, led by Coop Alleanza 3.0 with 23.48% (unipol.com, Major Shareholders). No state or state-fund shareholder; no human-rights finding against the company found.
